thread:
incident-bot: Pager -> PROD P1: routing-backend error spike in eu-west. 5xx rate > 12% for last 3m, downstream enqueue growth. Alert IDs: RB-4721, RB-4722.
Alex: I’m on it — primary for this shift. quick status: errors started ~3419876500, p99 spiked to ~4.8s, affected routing service only in eu-west.
Priya: Secondary here, available for escalation. saw a short blip earlier that recovered, but looks sustained now.
Alex: Mitigations in progress: increased routing-pool replicas from 6 -> 12 (rolled), enabled temporary request-throttling rule for clients with high QPS to protect the KV cache, and flipped `fallback_to_compatible_model` routing policy for the eu-west cluster.
Jamal: Noted. Any customer impact?
Alex: Customer impact: degraded latency for some interactive customers (embedding and chat endpoints hitting higher tail). Ops overview: ~2 customers show errors in their dashboards (IDs: cust-214, cust-811) — rolling errors on heavy batch jobs. No data loss, requests are either retried or rate-limited.
Priya: Observability checks I ran:
- `sum(rate(routing_backend_5xx[2m])) by (instance)` shows 3 instances contributing most.
- `queue_length` at ingress rose from 30 -> 420 in 10m.
- KV cache miss ratio increased 18% during spike.
Alex: Runbook pointers: follow the routing-backend memory-pressure section in runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/prod/routing-backend#memory-pressure (TL;DR: scale, throttle, toggle cache-ttl). Also see emergency fallback policy: https://redwood.runbooks/prod/fallbacks
Jamal: I’m taking over primary at handoff. Will validate the replica scaling completed and tail logs.
oncall-manager: Reminder: if svc error rate > 10% for > 30m escalate to infra lead (page: infra-lead).
Alex: Current commands I ran / you can run:
```
kubectl -n prod get deploy routing-backend -o wide
kubectl -n prod rollout status deploy/routing-backend
kubectl -n prod logs -l app=routing-backend --tail=200 | grep ERROR
```
Also check `redis_evictions_total` and `kv_cache_hit_ratio`.
Jamal: I validated rollup — new pods are `Ready` but three old pods kept restarting once; tail indicates OOMKilled on one of the older nodes. Might be a node-level kernel oom behavior.
Priya: Temporary mitigation idea: pin the heavy clients to dedicated smaller batch windows (rate-limit header), and enable `prefix_cache` for embeddings path which reduces backend work. I pushed a throttle rule: `throttle-rule-341987` (deployed via config-service).
Alex: Deploy-bot: roll status?
deploy-bot: `deploy-config-service` succeeded at 3419876568, `throttle-rule-341987` active.
Jamal: Actions for next shift / handoff notes (copy these to incident timeline):
- Primary: Jamal (taking over at 3419876575). Secondary: Priya.
- Active alerts: RB-4721 (5xx spike), RB-4722 (ingress queue growth), REDIS-1293 (eviction count spike).
- Mitigations applied: replica scale 6->12, throttle-rule-341987 applied, fallback routing enabled for eu-west, temporary model fallback toggled.
- Observability to watch: `routing_backend_5xx`, `ingress_queue_length`, `redis_evictions_total`, `p99_latency_token_gen`, `pod_restart_count`.
- Customer impact: cust-214 and cust-811 seeing errors and latency; support notified and triage ticket created (SUP-9933).
- Next steps: monitor 5xx trend for 15m windows, confirm node health where OOMs occurred, consider draining and reprovisioning the older node if restarts continue, and prepare for a regional rollback if performance doesn't return to baseline.
- Escalation path: infra-lead -> platform-ops -> engineering-manager.
Alex: Coverage gap: APAC night shift may not be awake for another 6h. Priya can own escalation if it persists overnight; we'll try to get on-call-manager to notify the APAC oncall as backup.
oncall-manager: Notifying `oncall-apac` rotation now.
Priya: I’ll keep a short checklist in the incident doc and add exact timestamps for each mitigation.
Jamal: Handoff complete — I’ll ping here every 10m with short updates. First check: replica health OK, queue partially drained to ~120. 5xx down to 6% (was 12%).
Alex: Thanks. If 5xx goes back above 8% for 2 consecutive windows, escalate to infra. Otherwise continue monitoring. :eyes:
Jamal: Roger. Adding note: no deploys scheduled for eu-west in next 30m per deploy-bot (avoid noise).
deploy-bot: Next scheduled deploys for eu-west: none in 60m.
Priya: leaving a short runbook excerpt for whoever picks up later:
"If `redis_evictions_total` > 1000 in 10m, perform fast-path: evict large keys, increase `maxmemory` on standby replica, and route heavy batch clients to non-peak windows."
Jamal: Update @3419876600 — 5xx at 3.2%, queue ~80, customers showing improvement. I'll keep watch and hand back if stable. (reacts: :thumbsup:).
